Name: Senaah
ModernLocation: Unknown; candidates include Khirbet el Aujah el Foqa and Khirbat al Beiyudat
Description: Senaah, also called Hassenaah, was a town whose people are counted among those who returned from exile, and whose sons built the Fish Gate in Nehemiah's wall.
BiblicalSignificance: Senaah is remembered both in the return census and on the wall: a town that came back and helped rebuild Jerusalem.
